description: A LOST OR SHARED PASS. Call it when a person wants their Wallet pass refreshed with a new code ("someone photographed my pass", "I want a fresh pass"), or when a host of a personal event or the organizer of an event wants a guest's pass revoked or refreshed. action "reissue" gives the pass a new QR code and brings a revoked pass back; the old code stops working at once and the phone shows "Your pass was refreshed. The old code no longer works." action "revoke" voids the pass on the phone: "This pass was revoked and no longer works." Nothing is re-added: the same pass updates in place on an iPhone and on Android. Without serialNumber it is the caller's own pass at that event; with one it is that pass, and the caller must be a host or the organizer. Say the outcome in one sentence. Accepts the event id or the event name.

action.description: REQUIRED. reissue (a new code, and a revoked pass comes back) or revoke (the pass is voided).

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event NAME as the organizer or the hosts spell it.

serialNumber.description: OPTIONAL. The pass serial (on the pass, ps_ and 24 characters). Omit for the caller's own pass.

name: event_pass_reissue
title: Refresh or revoke a Wallet pass
